meta.title: Agentic Banking Operations — Architecture & Agent Registry
meta.derived_from: McKinsey Operations Practice, 'AI in Asia: Reimagining banking operations through agentic AI', December 2025
meta.purpose: Reconstruct the agentic architecture and index every agent 'product' the report proposes by the use case it solves.
meta.notes: Improvement ranges are illustrative and based on McKinsey client engagements. Agent names are taken from report exhibits (1-19). This file is the canonical, machine-readable index; docs/AGENTIC_ARCHITECTURE.md is the human narrative.

value_thesis.cost_base_at_stake: Enterprise-wide operations = 60-70% of a bank's cost base
value_thesis.ai_cost_reduction: Up to 70% gross reduction in certain cost categories; ~15-20% of entire cost base net of rising tech cost
value_thesis.top_10_domains_cover: 60-70% of the total operations value pool
value_thesis.early_mover_impact: 30-50% efficiency gains, 2-3x productivity uplift (<10% of institutions globally are executing agentic AI at scale)
value_thesis.manual_baseline: ~60-70% of banking-operations workflows still rely on manual processing

architecture.paradigm: Multiagentic systems: fleets of dedicated atomic agents acting as coworkers, orchestrated with human-in-the-loop, that plan multistep work, use tools, self-critique, and collaborate.
why_beyond_single_llm: Automate complex multistep workflows (single LLM: single-shot tasks only)
Perform and trigger actions via tools
Auto-learn at high velocity with human reinforcement

capability_stack_layers.name: Engagement
capability_stack_layers.goal: Reimagine customer experience: personalized, streamlined, omnichannel.
elements: Mobile as the gateway to the rest of the bank (branch, contact center, RMs)
Omnichannel experiences for customers, employees, partners
Digital twins to simulate customer and employee behavior

capability_stack_layers.name: AI-powered decision-making
capability_stack_layers.goal: Data-based decisions that raise productivity and meet customer needs; realized through the 'agentic mesh'.
elements: AI orchestration (copilot-style support + autopilots that orchestrate workflows)
AI agents specialized in narrow domains (the agent library)
AI enablers, streamlined risk protocols, information-security standards

capability_stack_layers.name: Core technology and data
capability_stack_layers.goal: Modernize the stack for streamlined architecture and secure data exchange.
elements: Industrial AI and machine learning; MLOps; FinOps
Enterprise data: ingestion, preprocessing, vector databases, post-processing, structured stores
Modern API architecture; intelligent infrastructure; core modernization; cybersecurity and control tiers

capability_stack_layers.name: Platform operating model
capability_stack_layers.goal: Centralize talent, culture, and org design so autonomous business/tech/data teams are AI-enabled.

orchestration_brain.name: Orchestration brain / Master orchestrator
orchestration_brain.role: A universal AI agent layer that receives inbound requests in any channel, routes and orchestrates cases front-to-back, and hands off to specialized teams (human or agent) only when their expertise is required.
orchestration_brain.shift: From product/skill-oriented ops with multiple handoffs and high turnaround -> AI-first ops where agents independently progress work and involve humans as needed.

architecture.agentic_mesh: AI architecture paradigm that integrates both custom-built and off-the-shelf agents into the decisioning layer.

atomic_agent_framework.coverage_claim: 27 high-performing atomic agents can potentially automate ~90% of enterprise processes.
atomic_agent_framework.crosscutting_impact: Correctly implemented end-to-end/front-to-back, the 9 crosscutting agents can unlock 30-40% operational efficiency.
design_principles: Scalable to new use cases with minimal effort
Modular frameworks so agents are easily modified and assembled into new workflows

crosscutting_agents.name: Coordinate agent
crosscutting_agents.solves: Coordinates, assigns, prioritizes, and escalates cases/applications for optimized turnaround times.

crosscutting_agents.name: Prioritize agent
crosscutting_agents.solves: Prioritizes tasks for other agents or people based on criticality.

crosscutting_agents.name: Monitor agent
crosscutting_agents.solves: Monitors actions to flag breaches and resolve queries using domain expertise.

crosscutting_agents.name: Verify agent
crosscutting_agents.solves: Parses, reconciles, and validates documents to flag inconsistencies.

crosscutting_agents.name: Create agent
crosscutting_agents.solves: Creates context-specific documents by analyzing internal and external information to aid decision-making.

crosscutting_agents.name: Execute agent
crosscutting_agents.solves: Provides real-time execution support (e.g., sending calendar invites, emails) to boost productivity and speed.

crosscutting_agents.name: Call agent
crosscutting_agents.solves: Voice or chat agent that can chat with or call people where needed.

crosscutting_agents.name: Follow-up agent
crosscutting_agents.solves: Follows up with customers or employees at the right time and channel in a personalized manner.

crosscutting_agents.name: Coach agent
crosscutting_agents.solves: Provides personalized feedback and nudges to enhance performance, decision-making, and skills development.

capability_stack_narrow_agents.note: Representative, non-exhaustive narrow agents shown in the capability stack (Exhibit 4), grouped by the enabler they attach to.

domains.name: Customer journey transformation
domains.problem: Digitization fixes touchpoints, not the hundreds of underlying journeys/processes, so journeys feel fragmented and slow.
domains.solution: Redesign journey flows to remove friction, embed personalization, and give real-time transparency across underlying processes.
domains.flagship_use_case: SME current-account opening in 24-48 hours (from 5-8 days)

agent_teams.solves: Runs the end-to-end account-opening workflow, sequencing maker/checker steps.
Handholds the customer through form-filling and flags process delays in real time.

agents: Information verifier (form-vs-doc and doc-vs-doc mismatch, policy/regulatory checks)
agent_teams.solves: Auto-populates and validates documents; flags mismatches and policy breaches (e.g., current account exposure > $500k).

agents: Risk summarizer and next-swimlane generator (entity/proprietor identity fraud, business-continuity risk)
agent_teams.solves: Pulls internal + external data (loan records, statements, tax, blacklists, bureaus) to score risk and route Low/Medium/High.
Reminders to stakeholders by priority, prepares approval summaries, manages escalations.
Automated status updates, document reminders, and TAT insight generation for the frontline.

domains.name: Sales, branch, and distribution operations
domains.problem: Frontline productivity varies 30-50% between top and median performers; slow feedback loops hamper performance.
domains.solution: Real-time guidance, post-sales automation, and dynamic resource allocation across the salesperson's day.
domains.flagship_use_case: AI-led sales excellence across key moments of a salesperson's day

agent_teams.solves: What should I focus on today? Which files should I move? Where do I need my manager?
Which cases are critical to discuss and which offers grow business with the channel partner?
What is the best offer for the customer and what should my pitch be?
How do I improve my performance and what specifically must I do to get better?
What do I need from credit/legal/technical/operations to move files faster?

domains.name: Customer care and service centers
domains.problem: Service is reactive; high call volumes; <1% of calls reviewed for quality; simple queries rely on humans.
domains.solution: 'Contact center in a box' — a team of agents for workforce management, direct interaction handling, human copiloting, and always-on coaching.
domains.flagship_use_case: AI-first contact center + 100% call review / post-call insights

agent_teams.solves: AI-powered capacity planning across long-to-real-time horizons; matches supply and demand across incoming calls.
Handles voice+chat interactions in real time, escalates to human as needed, updates systems, summarizes at handoff.
Proactively suggests next-best actions and resource recommendations; automates notes/summaries/system updates.
Reviews 100% of interactions for quality and compliance and delivers targeted, personalized coaching.

domains.name: Lending and credit operations
domains.problem: Credit processes are memo-driven, inconsistent, and slow (3-5 day cycles); heavy manual review.
domains.solution: AI-led dossiers where customized agent teams spread financials, run policy checks, and price deals; only exceptions are routed to humans.
domains.flagship_use_case: End-to-end credit lending (financial spreading -> credit memo -> pricing & facility letter)

agents: Financial analysis agents (Information extractor, Financial analyst, Financial calculator, Planner, Critic, File manager)
agent_teams.solves: Extracts data from P&L/balance sheets, calculates indicators, synthesizes company activities and management strategy.

agents: Credit memo formatting agents (Planner, Editor, Chief editor, File manager)
Risk analysis agents (Financial expert/critic, Planner, Credit officer, File manager)
Executive overview agents (Planner, Critic, Credit rating specialist, Analyst, File manager)
agent_teams.solves: Produces a digital credit memo with red-amber-green scoring against each policy approval criterion; overall credit rating.

agent_teams.team: Phase 3 - Deal profitability, auto-decision & facility letter
agents: Initial pricing analysis agents (Financial analyst, RWA calculator, Interest rate calculator, Planner, Critic)
Facility letter agents (Credit risk secretary, Legal associate, Planner, Critic, File manager)
agent_teams.solves: Evaluates profitability, generates pricing with methodology reasoning, and drafts the facility letter or decline letter.

domains.name: Deposits, transaction banking, and payments
domains.problem: High transaction volumes and manual exception handling slow processing and raise liquidity risk.
domains.solution: Accelerate processing, auto-resolve exceptions, link exception handling directly to corporate self-service.
domains.flagship_use_case: ERP/file payment submission with automated exception management (e.g., 99,998 of 100,000 line items straight-through)

agents: AI exception model (checks payment-vs-invoice mismatch, spelling errors across linked systems)
agent_teams.solves: Runs exceptions through an AI model linked to all systems, suggests adjustments, auto-approves and resubmits without manual multi-system lookup.

domains.name: Collections operations
domains.problem: Static scripts and generic outreach cap recovery rates and can damage customer relationships.
domains.solution: Personalize outreach by customer profile/behavior; optimize offer, tone, and channel dynamically; prioritize for efficiency.
domains.flagship_use_case: AI-led personalized multichannel collections that raises self-cure and early-stage resolution

agents: Microsegmentation & recommendation engine (self-cure, PDM, VaR, allocation, repo/settlement, NPV)
Agent assistance (live prompts, personalized nudges via voice-to-text + historical calls)
agent_teams.solves: Uses internal + off-us + call-center data to allocate delinquent customers to self-cure / call-center / field and choose the optimized channel.

domains.name: Financial crime operations (KYC, AML, fraud)
domains.problem: Manual investigations cause high false positives, slow resolution, and heavy resource drain; digital fraud rising sharply.
domains.solution: Adaptive risk scoring and automated investigation that retrieve, validate, analyze, and generate risk summaries.
domains.flagship_use_case: Automated transaction analysis -> investigation -> auto-generated risk summary

agents: AI anomaly detection engine (flags abnormal behavior vs profile & past behavior)
agent_teams.solves: Replaces analysts manually reviewing 13 months of transactions in spreadsheets (~50% of analyst time on retrieval/cleaning).
Runs detailed, consistent transaction analysis and customer assessment with human-in-the-loop for missing data.
Auto-generates the risk summary report instead of thousands drafted manually per year.

domains.name: Next-gen corporate functions (Finance, HR, IT, Legal, Procurement)
domains.problem: Document-heavy, cycle-time-bound support functions; ~60% of finance effort is transactional/compliance; backward-looking reporting.
domains.solution: Shift from reporting to forward-looking value management; automate transactional work; new roles (FP&A outcome designers, AI agent developers, AI compliance architects).
domains.flagship_use_case: AI-led annual budget creation; AI-managed HR payroll inquiries

agent_teams.solves: Automates guidance prep, cost-data gathering, budget generation and scenarios; CFO/LT review and approve.

agents: Intake agent (logs & classifies, routes to tier)
Payroll agent (adapts to regulatory changes, initiates/confirms payment)
agent_teams.solves: Handles Tier 1/2 payroll inquiries end-to-end with human oversight for data integrity.

domains.name: Operations carve-out — centralization and shared services
domains.problem: Finance/HR/IT/legal/procurement shared functions are ticket-heavy, fragmented, and siloed.
domains.solution: Centralize into horizontal Centers of Excellence (CoEs) with reusable AI components for a cross-functional operational backbone.
domains.flagship_use_case: Four CoEs powering shared services from onboarding to collections

metrics.metric: Processing cost (centralized credit assessment & doc checks)

agent_teams.solves: Centralizes cloud solutions, data centers, and digital platforms.
Drives better decision-making through unified data and reporting.
Consolidates support functions into shared platforms.
Embeds intelligent automation across functions via reusable components and standardized models.

domains.name: Zero-based design (ZBD / ZBO)
domains.problem: Legacy structures create inefficiency and duplication; incremental optimization is insufficient.
domains.solution: Redesign the operating model from a clean slate; every process/capability/role justified by measurable value; ~1 human supervising 20-30 autonomous agents.
domains.flagship_use_case: Clean-slate redesign of the 10 domains around digital self-service, automation, and offshore/nearshore integration
zbo_levers: Lean process redesign (remove bottlenecks and waste)
Digital and technology (automate and integrate workflows)
Capability development (build digital and analytical skills)

agents: Self-optimizing multiagentic layer across all 10 domains
agent_teams.solves: Continuously learns and self-optimizes, eliminating friction and duplication and driving accountability.

transformation_framework.note: Five enterprise capabilities required to scale (Exhibit 19).

capabilities.name: Business-driven road map
essentials: Bold bankwide AI-ops vision linked to strategy and financial outcomes
Prioritize high-value domains for end-to-end transformation
Delivery road map with owners and milestones

capabilities.name: Talent
essentials: Right roles, reporting structure, and skills to drive innovation and execution

capabilities.name: Operating model and governance
essentials: Cross-functional 'garages' of domain experts, data scientists, transformation leaders
Close collaboration across business, ops, risk

capabilities.name: Technology and data
essentials: Agent library of reusable atomic agents for rapid deployment and monitoring

capabilities.name: Adoption and scaling
essentials: Structured change agenda and new ways of working

sequencing: Prioritize domains by value and strategic relevance
Target the highest-friction processes within each domain (manual verifications, payment exceptions, reconciliations)
Build the common crosscutting transformer agents first (reduce redundancy, enable scaling)
Then add domain-specific / niche agents for specialized processes
Develop governance and data discipline along the journey to build confidence and buy-in
common_pitfalls: Technology-first, hyperscaler-driven pilots with unclear value -> use a use-case-led road map with sized value levers and dashboards
One-size-fits-all vendor products -> design a custom, fit-for-purpose agentic solution with functional teams
Underinvesting in change management / capability building -> embed structured change with clear deliverables per phase
